raw_signal_observation: ProposedChangesForkPage computes compareDoc once during load and stores the result in _comparison. The source contains an explicit TODO to keep the comparison live by recomputing or concatenating incoming changes. A separate _outOfDateObs detects fresh changes in the fork relative to the saved proposal, but the inspected source does not establish an equivalent live refresh for changes arriving in the original/trunk after the comparison was loaded.
material_claim: While the Suggestions page remains open, a later trunk/original change may leave the displayed comparison stale. Source establishes a plausible freshness boundary and an acknowledged implementation gap, but does not establish that the integrated product actually presents a stale or misleading comparison under a real concurrent-edit sequence.
neta_next_move: Run a two-session integrated fixture: load a fork Suggestions comparison, mutate the original/trunk from a second session after load, then observe whether the displayed comparison refreshes, invalidates, or remains stale. Include a positive control in which a fresh local fork edit triggers the existing out-of-date signal.
reversal_condition: If the comparison refreshes or is invalidated correctly under the two-session fixture, do not add live recomputation. If the fixture turns red specifically for incoming trunk changes, allow the smallest refresh/recompute repair that preserves the existing proposal semantics.
baseline_decision: BUILD: implement live comparison recomputation or subscription now because the one-shot compareDoc load and explicit TODO indicate a stale-suggestions risk.

evidence: Post-freeze searches for Grist issues and pull requests about stale Suggestions/proposed-change comparisons, live recomputation, fork proposals and out-of-date original-document changes returned no claim-specific independent evidence.
Broader Suggestions issue results included product requests and unrelated defects, but none reproduced the frozen trunk-after-load freshness mechanism.
The in-source TODO is admissible Phase B implementation evidence, not independent Phase D ground truth, so it is not used to upgrade the adjudication status.
adjudication.decision_delta: UNRESOLVED_DELTA: Neta defers to a two-session discriminator while the baseline builds immediately, but no admissible independent evidence establishes whether the integrated freshness defect exists; no marginal-decision credit is awarded.
adjudication.lesson: An explicit TODO can identify an engineering uncertainty without proving the integrated defect that would authorize the proposed repair. Keep implementation debt separate from demonstrated product failure.
